02/06.12.2025 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Dhanbad P.S. Case No. 164 of 2017 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 1224 of 2017, for the offences registered under Sections 467, 468,
471, 420, 511, 120B of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Dhanbad.
3. Petitioner was appointed as teacher in Upgraded Middle School, Fatehpur, Nirsa-2, Dhanbad.
During the course of document verification, certificate of Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) of the petitioner was found to be forged.
4. It was submitted that petitioner has himself become victim of the circumstance.
It was further submitted that petitioner did not join his duty.

5. In view of the submissions made above, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad in connection with Dhanbad P.S.
